---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or a new app
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What problem does this solve?**
A short description of the use case.

**Proposed feature**
What you'd like the firmware to do. If it's a new app, describe its screens and
controls.

**Hardware needed**
Any external module/wiring this would require (or "none").

**Scope check**
This project is passive / receive-only and own-device only. Confirm the request
does not involve active radio attacks (deauth, jamming, injection, spam, replay,
handshake cracking). Requests of that kind are out of scope.

**Additional context**
Links, references or sketches, if any.
